user.title: Unraid SSH
user.description: Address of the Unraid server. The next step shows the SSH key this integration generates for itself — no password is stored.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Unraid server, without protocol; the SSH port is a separate field.
data_description.port: Port of the SSH service on Unraid; default 22, see Settings → Management Access.
data_description.name: Title of the entry in Home Assistant; it also becomes the prefix of every entity id, so keep it distinct from other Unraid integrations.

key.title: Authorize the key on Unraid

reauth_confirm.title: Unraid rejected the connection

data_description.accept_host_key: Trust the host key the server presents now; leave off unless Unraid was reinstalled or its SSH keys were regenerated.

reconfigure.title: Change address
reconfigure.description: New host or port; the SSH key stays the same and is tested against the new address.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Unraid server, without protocol.
data_description.port: Port of the SSH service on Unraid; default 22.

error.cannot_connect: The server could not be reached on that host and port.
error.key_rejected: The server rejected the key — has it been added to root.pubkeys and authorized_keys?
error.host_key_changed: The server's host key differs from the stored one.
error.not_unraid: The connection worked, but the server does not look like Unraid (no var.ini).
error.key_unreadable: The stored SSH key could not be read; remove the entry and set it up again.

abort.already_configured: This host and port are already set up.

init.title: Unraid SSH options
init.description: How often to poll, and how often to check images for updates.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two SSH polls of system, disks, containers and VMs; default 30, allowed 10 to 300.
data_description.update_interval: Hours between two checks of the container images against their registries; default 6, allowed 1 to 24. The button on the server device runs a check at any time.

server_action_busy.message: A server action is already running. Wait and check the server state.

server_update_active.message: Container updates are active. Wait for the update queue to finish.

server_poll_failed.message: Current server state could not be checked. Check the Unraid connection.

server_action_uncertain.message: Request status is uncertain. Check the connection and server state before trying again.

server_action_failed.message: Unraid rejected the request. Check the server state.

unknown_state.message: Server or parity state is unknown or a recovery operation is active. Check Unraid.

array_start_blocked.message: Normal array start is not confirmed safe. Check configuration, disks and pools in Unraid.

array_not_started.message: The array is not in its normal started state.

parity_not_running.message: No normal parity check is running.

parity_not_paused.message: No normal parity check is paused.

parity_not_active.message: No normal parity check is active.

sync_active.message: A parity or synchronization operation is active. Wait for it to finish.

parity_missing.message: Available parity disks could not be confirmed.

mover_active.message: Mover is active or its state is unknown. Check Unraid.
